findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived static key material increases the impact of key compromise and violates common compliance baselines for audit log encryption keys.

No explicit policy is attached to the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy granting the entire account root (and thus any IAM principal with KMS permissions in the account) full control over the key. For an audit-trail encryption key this means broad, unscoped access to decrypt audit logs.
